THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT, (Section 460)
Notice under Section 7
Ref No.: MTR/LND/ACQUI/L1/3938. L. M. Ref. No. 4-3/9/2012/IR/335.

I, hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as Amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude which is required for a public purpose.

The following blocks of Land situated in the Villages of Kekanadura and Deeyagaha in the 447 A Kekanadura central and 447 C Kekanadura-North and Deeyagaha West Grama Niladhari Divisions in the Matara Divisional Secretariat Division Matara District, Southern Province, mentioned in Preliminary Plan No. 2666 as from Lot 1 to 42 will be acquired for the construction of Samara Deniya Tank.
